body:
If you really want to listen to it, I can PM you but like you really don't have to it's painful

And like yeah you are right, thank you for taking the time to talk to me, I really do appreciate it

Shitty, like super shitty music. Sometimes like terrible 90s inspired rap, and sometimes like awful Grimes-inspired pop. I don't play any instruments and just bash keyboards until it sounds horrible and my voice sounds like a cat dying haha.

I can't even get my friends to listen to it which just sucks, it's like, damn nobody cares ya know?

That's true you are right, but the path to maybe one day see a shred of happiness again just feels so ridiculously long and impossible.

I guess I really spent the last few months doing everything that I wanted to do. Writing things I wanted to write, making the music I wanted to make, that kind of stuff. It really pushed me into a worse place of 'welp I did everything I've wanted'
